mods.name: Better Than Fishing
mods.description: This mod aims to expand the fishing system of BTA by adding new items, blocks, and recipes. And is it really better than fishing...? I don't know-

releases.notes:
# Warning!
If you have already created a world with BTF 1.0.4, consider changing the .cfg file, as for compatbility reasons, block IDs have changed from starting at 6000 to 6200.

## ¿What's new?
- Added Rice as crop and food material
- Added Flint Knife
- Added Iron and Gold cans
- Fishing loot table drops rebalanced and expanded
- Added Fishing Gear: Bobbers, Hooks, Bait and Tackle Boxes
- Added about 40+ new recipes
- Added Iridescite Shards
- Added Stardew Farming Compatibility (+ You can add your own fish to the table too btw)
- Added new custom paintings
- Added configuration file

## Fixes and others
- Fixed missing recipes and possible cases where recipes do not load.
- Fixed wrong render on Iridescite tolos
- Swapped render on skewer ítems
- Fixed torches being able to be placed on chopping tables
- Fixed items not rotating properly on chopping tables
- Separated client-only to avoid any further server crashes
- Overhauled Guidebook's chopping section
